issues.title: Ambiguous SSH Signing Implementation
issues.why: The spec says it 'shells out to ssh-keygen' but doesn't provide the exact command string or how to handle the resulting signature file/stdout for the X-GL-Signature header.
issues.fix: Define the exact shell command and how to extract the base64 signature from the .sig file or stdout.

issues.title: Missing Streaming Chunk Examples
issues.why: While NDJSON is mentioned, there is no worked example of a 'StreamHeader' or 'StreamFooter' JSON object in the examples section, only in the contract prose.
issues.fix: Add a 'Worked Example: Streaming' section showing the sequence of 3-4 JSON chunks.

issues.title: Vague 'interleaved' capture requirement
issues.why: Section 04 says 'capture stdout + stderr interleaved with timestamps', but doesn't specify if timestamps are internal metadata or prepended to the Log strings.
issues.fix: Clarify that timestamps are used for internal sorting and MUST NOT be prepended to the raw log lines unless [push].preserve_timestamps is true.
